description:
Oddisz's Mods
Every mod I've made is in this list.
PLEASE CONTACT ME IMMEDIATELY ON DISCORD IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS - AI WILL FIX IT INSTANTLY
AI Use disclaimer:
I ONLY make mods using AI. I am way too tired to learn starsector modding after my day job. I make mods for myself, and post them here if people want to grab them.

Colonies and industry

Astral Ascension Renewed
An Omega core can govern your colony and take it past size 10, up to
size 15. Colonies grow into Arcology Worlds, Ecumenopolises and
Hyper-Ecumenopolises with an orbital ring. A remake of Planetace's
Astral Ascension.

Screenshots

Omega Core Everywhere
Omega cores drop from destroyed Omega ships. An Omega core in a colony
building finally does something, usually something absurd. Covers
vanilla buildings plus Industrial Evolution, Vaults of Knowledge and
Terraforming and Station Construction.

Cloning
A three-tier cloning industry that massively boosts population growth,
at a growing cost to stability. For when you do not want to wait years
for a size 9 colony.

Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal
A Reverse Engineering Hub that takes apart your weapons, fighters and
ships, then sells copies back to you in a Private Arsenal only you can
use. Upgrade the hub and it makes the blueprints too. A remake of an
industry from DarkQOL

Screenshots

Toolbox Economy Curves
An add-on for AoTD - Theory of Toolbox. Choose different modes of
production and consumption of resources - ToT handles very high planet
sizes poorly - This mod alleviates this issue.

Campaign content

Sol Renewed
Adds Sol: the eight planets, Pluto and the moons that matter, sized
and spaced for gameplay instead of realism like Bugatti's Sol so you
can actually function within it.
Sol is not there at the start: you bring it into the sector with the
"Transferring Sol" quest. (Or skip the quest in the LunaSettings)

Screenshots

Gambling Den
A gambling den at every large market. Sell hulls you will never fly
for tokens, then play Slots, Pachinko, Pinball, Blackjack or the Relic
Jackpot for credits, weapon crates, fighter crates and hull mod boxes.
Cheat mod for a soft-gameplay way of getting more hullmod blueprints
faster in highly-modded playthroughs.

Screenshots

Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition
Pour credits, materials and story points into the ships you love at
any friendly market, until they are as overpowered as you can afford.
Only your ships: enemy fleets never get any of it. A from-scratch
remake of Extra System Reloaded.

Interface and quality of life

Hullmods - Renewed
Adds a filter panel to the refit screen's hull mod picker: search,
favourites, a blacklist and custom groups. Set it up once and every
playthrough keeps it.

Screenshots

Intel Renewed
Decide what the intel screen shows. Hide whole kinds of entries,
categories or single entries, drop the empty category buttons, and
search the list. Nothing is deleted, everything can be turned back on.

StopBloatingMe
Browse every ship, weapon and fighter in your modlist from the main
menu and blacklist the ones you never want to see again. The 15th
recolour of the Onslaught is gone from every future playthrough.

Screenshots

StopStackingMe
Draws one sprite per cargo stack, instead of several greyed-out ghost
copies behind it when multiple copies of a weapon are in one
inventory. Helps with visual clutter.

StarterPack
Build a starting fleet, cargo and character once from the main menu,
and apply it to every new game you start. Useful for testing or
setting up a common start between playthroughs.

Screenshots

Discord Rich Presence
Shows your commander name, level, credits and flagship as your Discord
status while you play.

Screenshots

Mod pack

Coalesced Little Mods (no thread yet, links to GitHub)
Eight of my small mods in one download: Cloning, Private Arsenal,
StopBloatingMe, StopStackingMe, Intel Renewed, Hullmods - Renewed,
Gambling Den and StarterPack. The ones that add campaign content each
have their own on/off switch in LunaLib.
I made this from a request - But I don't use it myself. Feel free to
use this pack if you're too lazy to download all of them manually, i
guess.

Tools

Starsector Mod Checker
Not a mod: a small program you run before playing. It reads every
enabled mod the way the game does and lists the files that would crash
Starsector or break it, by mod, folder and file. Runs on the Java that
comes with the game.
